plan.because: Health effects are reported; obtain findings and any limits on attributed cause. Prioritise immediate health and safety needs.
The supplied lease identifies the parties and some terms but does not identify the rented property; request the complete contract.
The reported telephone notices do not establish their full contents and dates. Request any records or written confirmations.
The dates and receipt of the reported defect notices need evidence.
Obtain dated evidence of the affected locations and visible condition.
Mould and condensation are reported; dated moisture and temperature observations are relevant.
A heating fault is reported; request any service findings and inspection date.
Document the landlord's responses, proposed work and access arrangements.
A specialist inspection is considered necessary; obtain any technical findings while keeping the cause open.
The customer intends to consider official rent deposit; request any communicated repair deadline and its contents.
This document is optional under the process.

questions: Is anyone currently at immediate health or safety risk? Seek urgent medical or emergency assistance if needed.
When did the faults begin, and on which dates and to whom were the three reports made?
Are there existing photos, measurements, service reports or records of the landlord's response and access arrangements?
Has a written repair deadline been sent to the landlord, and has any rent already been deposited?
